summary: Completed testing of Comptabilité (Accounting) refactoring features for La Bague Impériale cigar club app. All features working correctly.

issues: Minor: React hydration warnings in console (span inside tbody) - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

seed_data_creation: Test transactions, dettes, and virements created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comptabilité page refactoring complete. All features tested: Détails modal for comptes, Dehors (Dettes) modal with MEMBRE/DOIT/CAUSE format, Règlement modal with Shadcn Select dropdown, Virement modal, Nouveau mouvement form with Shadcn Select dropdowns.

page_comptabilite_load.details: Page loads correctly with financial summary (Solde Total, Total Recettes, Total Dépenses)

comptes_display.details: All 6 comptes displayed with correct balances: Compte Bancaire, PayPal, Chez Fabien, Chez Jacques, Dehors, Asso Connect

details_button_comptes.details: Détails button opens modal showing movements for each caisse (7 Détails buttons found)

dehors_dettes_card.details: Dehors (Dettes) card shows total dettes (480€) and count (5 dettes badge)

dehors_modal.details: Modal Détails : Dehors displays list of dettes with MEMBRE, DOIT, CAUSE format and Réglé buttons

reglement_modal.details: Régler une dette modal shows dette details, Shadcn Select dropdown for compte selection, and Confirmer le règlement button

virement_modal.details: Faire un virement button opens modal with source/destination compte selects, montant input, and Effectuer le virement button

nouveau_mouvement_form.details: Form has Date input, 4 Shadcn Select dropdowns (Type, Membre, Objet, Caisse), Montant input, Détail input, and Ajouter le mouvement button

mouvements_table.details: Table displays all columns: Date, Type, Membre, Objet, Montant, Caisse, Détail, Actions

api_comptes.details: Returns all 6 comptes with correct structure

api_dettes.details: Returns all dettes with membre_id, montant, cause

api_virements.details: Virements between comptes work correctly, including Dehors (virtual account)

api_transactions.details: CRUD operations work correctly, account balances update automatically

dette_reglement_workflow.details: Full workflow tested: Create dette → Virement from Dehors → Delete dette
